newsitem.title: USA: Donegal withdraws Old Guard offer.
newsitem.headline: Donegal withdraws Old Guard offer.

text.p: Donegal Group Inc said Friday it had withdrawn its offer to acquire Old Guard Group Inc after repeated requests to meet with Old Guard's directors to discuss its proposal were rejected.

Donegal's had proposed to acquire Old Guard, the holding company for Old Guard Insurance Co, Old Guard Fire Insurance Co and Goschenhoppen-Home Insurance Co, from the policyholders of those companies.

Donegal said it believes its proposal was still in the best interests of the policyholders of the Old Guard companies, it does not intend to pursue a hostile attempt to acquire Old Guard and its insurance subsidiaries.

It said it will continue its policy of seeking acquisitions of property and casualty insurance companies at reasonable valuations to expand its operations both within and beyond its current operations.
Donegal is a property-casualty insurance holding company doing business in Pennsylvania, Delaware, Maryland, Ohio and Virginia.
